name: Ai Focus
source:
As a member of the Photography Club, you've been appointed as the official photographer for the graduation yearbook.

Though the shoot proceeds smoothly overall, you face just one nagging problem: Whenever you pointed the camera at one particular student, his smile would freeze up.

At this rate, wouldn’t he be the only one without a wonderful photo?
Just as you begin to rack your brains over the dilemma, he approaches you with a certain "proposal" of his own...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11682]Novelgame[/url]]
